name: Snow Queen 5
author: Addicting Games
description: Snow Queen 5 is a free jewel game. The Snow Queen is here, she is back, and she is looking for revenge. It will be up to you to generate the energy and the power needed in order to devestate the queen herself. You'll have to mine the energy by matching your way through the jewel mines. All you have to do is swap, swipe, and drag the rows or columns of the jewels in order to line up at least three of like colors. Can you do it? We think you can, in fact we know you can. Another thing we know is that once you get started you're going to love it. Games like these are a lot of fun and after all the Snow Queen wouldn't keep coming back if she wasn't having fun herself. So, anyway, get swiping! This is the ultimate free match 3 games. Whether you want to match the jewels, ornaments, spheres, or all sorts of other glittering bulbs. Just get three in a row and you'll be on your way to victory. Most importantly you'll be able to appease the dreaded Snow Queen. Some say the snow queen is nice, some say she is not really so nice. In our opinion, she is honestly fine but she is very picky and like other monarchs, she didn't exactly work for her position so there is a certain amount of entitlement. The Snow Queen also doesn't know much about the match 3 industry.
